'''Thalassian Sentinels''' are high elven guards located at various locations throughout the [[Thalassian Highlands]]. They can be found patrolling the roads and stationed in [[Brinthilien]]. They are flagged for PvP and will attack any member of the Horde on sight. They can provide directions to various locations in the [[Thalassian Highlands]] and [[Alah'Thalas]].
